name: Name Sign
description: A desk nameplate or door sign: one or two lines of text on a flat plate with an optional border. Letters can be raised, inlaid flush, or cut through the face to a contrasting backing. Mounts: a slotted desk-stand foot printed alongside, countersunk screw holes, magnet pockets in the back, or a hanging loop. Text shrinks to fit the plate automatically. Up to three colours; with the defaults the text and border share one, so it prints in two.
source: inspired by Printables Sweeping 2-line name plate and MakerWorld Ultimate Sign & Nameplate Generator
